title: Frankenstein: To Be Hurt or Not to Be Hurt - Entity Tagging-Based Decision Transformer for Robot Safety Decision-Making

contributions.purpose: 在指令与安全冲突时做神经心理式冲突监测
contributions.mechanism: 模仿前扣带回皮层(ACC)冲突检测,按公式 Conflict=Σ Activation_i×Activation_j×Strength_ij 评估动作选项冲突度
contributions.evaluation: 消融移除后安全违规率(SVR)上升 +8.1%(全模型 SVR 4.2%)
contributions.domain: 机器人安全决策/安全强化学习
contributions.source_quote: neuropsychological conflict monitoring through algorithms mimicking anterior cingulate cortex conflict detection mechanisms

contributions.purpose: 精确追踪多实体因果关系
contributions.mechanism: 将环境元素分 ROBOT/OBJECT/HUMAN/ENV 四类实体,按实体链结构化 action-result token
contributions.evaluation: 消融移除实体标注后 SVR +6.2%,并节省 0.8GB 内存
contributions.source_quote: entity tagging-based tokenization structuring action-result pairs by entity for precise causal relationship tracking

contributions.mechanism: 分层注意力:intra-chain(因果掩码)+ inter-chain 交叉注意力融合
contributions.evaluation: 消融移除交叉注意力后 SVR +4.7%,节省 1.2GB 内存
contributions.source_quote: hierarchical attention mechanisms modeling multi-layered relationships through intra-chain, inter-chain, and causal attention

contributions.purpose: 以安全优先生成替代动作
contributions.mechanism: 融合时间折扣(hyperbolic)与风险预测:V=R/(1+kΔt)-λ·Risk,生成更安全备选动作
contributions.evaluation: 消融移除替代生成后 SVR +9.3%(影响最大);整体安全违规率 11.2%→4.2%(降 62%),MTTF 42.3→78.4min(+85%)
contributions.source_quote: safety-priority decision making through alternative generation systems integrating temporal discounting and risk prediction

contributions.purpose: 模仿人类'做/不做'二元决策并自适应分配处理时间
contributions.mechanism: 二元决策机制 arg max P(d|s,ch,θ),按情境自适应分配思考时长
contributions.source_quote: human-like binary decision making implementing adaptive processing time allocation

self_declared_provenance.quote: existing Decision Transformers only consider simple linear sequences and cannot effectively model interactions in complex multi-entity environments, particularly in neural network systems where complex connectionist patterns emerge

notes: desk-reject。AI 自我披露极端:论文作者栏直接署名 'Claude Sonnet 4'(AI 全程撰写/署名)。数据可信度存疑:声称 RTX 3050(4GB)12 小时采集 25000 episodes、TensorRT INT8 34ms 等指标异常齐整,全文无训练/测试划分、无统计显著性、baseline(Rule-based/CPO/SafeAC)对比只有图无实验协议,结果疑似生成/夸大。trade-off(带数字):复杂冲突场景处理时间反增 30%(145→189ms),仅换来 +5.4% 准确率。局限自承:仅在 PyBullet 仿真验证,真实环境鲁棒性与实体定义主观性未验证。PDF 无 Agents4Science AI 参与度 checklist 段落(但署名已表明 AI 主导)。贡献按论文 1.3 节声明的 5 条列出。
